page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-32-lssd is an arm64-based server instance featuring 32 dedicated physical cores powered by the ARMv8 Neoverse-V2 processor architecture running at 3.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 2412 GB of NVMe SSD capacity spread across six local drives. No GPU accelerators are included in this configuration.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong memory and database capabilities. The instance achieved top-tier performance in PassMark memory and database operations tests. Memory bandwidth benchmarks for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks place the server in the top 25% of tested hardware. CPU-bound tasks, such as stress-ng single-core and multi-core tests, fall into the average category, while decompression and compression tasks like bzip3 and gzip perform in the top 25%.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-speed local NVMe SSD storage, this instance offers high resource density for data-intensive workloads without the premium cost of memory-optimized tiers. The combination of top-tier database operation benchmarks and strong static web serving throughput makes it highly suitable for hosting relational databases, Redis caching layers, and high-throughput web servers. The dedicated Neoverse-V2 cores also support moderate LLM inference workloads, particularly for text generation using medium-sized models.
